topology_interpretation: XCLK drives ckp/ckn into both the release latch and the parent main master/slave clock receivers. The parent master receives reversed ckn/ckp; the parent slave receives ckp/ckn. The release slave also receives reversed clock polarity.

XRELEASE drives releasedp/releasedn into XRUN. XRUN has separate native resistor paths from external ARM and release to its bases, a positive-base shunt XAND_SKEW, collector loads, series output resistors, shunts and MIM feed-forward capacitors. Its output drives all four parent DATA/HOLD selectors.

Inside each selector XSA controls the data-input branch and XSB the seed branch. Their collector currents and distinct local terminal voltages are retained without equating Ic with Ie or enforcing a whole-network KCL.

The source native-level positive internal collector is XLN.C and its negative internal collector is XLP.C. Positive/negative receiver pairs below are oriented by logical CKP/CKN, including explicit reversal of the release slave and main master.

The qualified M4 change altered exactly twelve selector tail M4 widths. It did not change the source schematic or the clock/run device sizes. That preservation establishes the current lineage, not the physical cause of current timing failures.

Distributed current-model contacts are distinct. The reported native_clock probe is the pair of XCLK output resistor far terminals, not the actual receiving transistor base pair. An internal diagnostic pair is not a new acceptance test.

selected_rows_scope.stage_row_selection: Two exact native rows bracketing each original parent deadline, each parent native-clock falling-zero event and each parent release rising-zero event. No interpolation.
selected_rows_scope.evidence_pointers: All rows refer to /frames/<row> in the immutable complete witness. HBT fields use /hbt/<native>; passive values use /passive_accesses/xdut:<source_instance>/terminal_voltages_v; pair fields use /pairs/<pair>. Complete source role and passive native-node mappings remain in the same witness.

collector_to_output_voltage_decompositio.identity: Dout = Dc - Apos + Aneg - Rpos + Rneg - Fpos + Fneg, where A is collector minus series-near terminal, R is series-near minus series-far terminal, F is series-far minus observed output node, and D is positive minus negative.
collector_to_output_voltage_decompositio.interpretation: This identity separates the native wire/contact voltage difference from the intrinsic rppd terminal voltage difference without assigning either a current, resistance, capacitive current, or causal share of delay.
collector_to_output_voltage_decompositio.original_tail_headroom_identity: VCE_XT = (B_XSA-E_XT) - VBE_XSA - (E_XSA-C_XT), and likewise XSB; the corrected minus-wire sign remains unchanged in the complete witness.

observations: At row7071 (first original deadline bracket), XCLK base differential is -95.337619 mV, internal collector differential +53.368527 mV, output probe +96.260257 mV, and actual slave clock receiver bases +144.511421 mV.
At row7221, the native-clock probe is only +0.296925 mV while the actual slave clock receiver bases remain +46.573426 mV. At row47672, corresponding values are +0.007649 mV and +38.154343 mV.
The actual saved rows distinguish upstream base, internal collector, resistor terminals and receiving bases; they do not locate the exact new pair crossing times between existing selected frames.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic conditioning, output loading and distributed receiver access response contribute to the observed lag and sign differences.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.unresolved: Separate transistor response, intrinsic resistor/MIM behavior and distributed RC loading cannot be causally apportioned from these rows.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.discriminating_readback: Measure native brackets/extrema for XCLK bases, collectors, output-series near terminals and all four actual clock receiver pairs on the unchanged saved capture.

observations: The post-start parent run maximum is only +48.315065 mV. At that exact row10080 external ARM is +170.631090 mV and release +142.788816 mV, XRUN base difference +30.701051 mV and collector difference +82.528129 mV.
At row10080 XRUN XLP/XLN collector current observations are approximately 0.989101/0.589283 mA. The pair is not fully one-sided; no current-sum assertion is made.
At the original deadline rows run and all parent selector base differences are negative; at row7071 slave DATA XSA/XSB Ic are 0.057890/1.183589 mA and HOLD XSA/XSB Ic 0.057728/1.181780 mA.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.hypothesis: The loaded ARM/release fan-in, fixed negative decision bias and output loading leave a small run differential and delayed selector release.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.unresolved: The data does not establish that the deliberate shunt, an intrinsic device, a particular wire, or a capacitance is the cause; no shunt or device change is justified yet.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.discriminating_readback: Measure XRUN base/collector/series-near brackets and extrema alongside existing release/ARM/run and actual selected receiving-base frames, preserving prescribed timing.

observations: Parent slave has no post-start zero bracket and stays positive; the Q-child fixture input is this exact parent-slave pair. The Q-child missing release/run transitions therefore cannot be explained only by a late isolated output edge.
At original parent deadlines, actual clock receiver state and selector current preference differ across the path. Master/slave DATA and HOLD paths retain separate native contacts.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.hypothesis: Clock receiver timing and selector state jointly limit propagation into the slave and the Q child.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.unresolved: Neither a Boolean state label nor a transistor failure is inferred solely from current extrema or one complete row.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.discriminating_readback: Add actual slave DATA/HOLD receiving differential pairs to localize whether the signal is absent before the latch input or lost across the latch.

observations: All318 original post-start HBT numeric safety gates pass on this current capture. The four old parent tail minima have margins 5.323531,3.506110,1.241706 and0.793372 mV above the unchanged0.4 V floor.
Clock/run HBT same-row VCE values in the selected windows do not show a new0.4 V floor violation. Passing this floor does not establish sufficient transconductance, drive, bandwidth or noise margin.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.hypothesis: The prior explicit tail VCE rejection is resolved in this capture; other bias/loading limitations remain possible.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.unresolved: No safety threshold is relaxed and no comparison of extrema from different runs is treated as causal A/B evidence.
measurement_supported_hypotheses.discriminating_readback: Retain all318 native safety records and all17 historical minimum selections unchanged; add no new device floor or acceptance definition.

next_cloud_experiment_proposal.observations: For each added pair compute both-sign extrema and exact native neighbor brackets at -0.1,0,+0.1 V, using the same zero-plateau departure convention. Preserve all original six prescribed first-fall windows and fixed samples. Add complete native frames for every selected added-pair extremum and window-crossing bracket, then require exact resource-plan/final-row/time equality.
next_cloud_experiment_proposal.original_numerical_review: Replay the unchanged original review once; require exact current prior result equality. Added internal pairs are diagnostic only and cannot change original phase/preset/first-fall/safety verdicts.
next_cloud_experiment_proposal.publication: Publish complete bounded diagnostic JSON and compact full index directly from the first publication, with source/run/model/capture hashes and native row pointers. Do not hide observations in an archive.
next_cloud_experiment_proposal.resource_contract: Recompute finite input-derived frame/crossing/association bounds for the expanded36-pair selector plan. Preserve current storage/memory/output limits and complete failure envelopes; do not truncate, sample, widen bounds blindly, or mark partial diagnosis complete.
meaningful_source_controls_required: Each new endpoint must resolve uniquely to the authenticated source role/native terminal. Wrong native node, reversed receiver polarity, missing saved vector and wrong model/capture identity must fail.
Original24-pair output/index selection, six prescribed windows, fixed references, zero-plateau crossing convention and original replay must remain exact.
Plan and final selected rows/time must agree exactly for all new extrema and bracket endpoints; exact-row equality must retain duplicate bracket semantics without duplicating frame allocation.

Exercise actual complete snapshot restoration/reconstruction, main failure/finalization, resource refusal and reserved direct publication paths; all authorization mutations must genuinely alter both legitimate modes.
next_cloud_experiment_proposal.limitations: This readback can locate where attenuation/lag appears along native contacts. It cannot by itself prove the physical cause or replace a later separately reviewed causal intervention experiment with fresh native simulation.
